facts.fact: Capacity Media reports MOZIX, run by CIUEM, is Mozambique's sole IXP with 19 active peering members, and opened a new point of presence at Digital Realty's MPM1 data centre in Maputo.
Traffic: over 150 Gbps (peak) at MOZIX on 2025-05-15, with 19 peering members, as stated by CIUEM's director; the article gives no separate measurement date, so the publication date is used.

note: No reach fact: sole IXP stated but members not described as only local.
